title: RAW UNREVIEWED: context selects occurrence expansions within a separately frozen unpaired candidate inventory
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Conditional on successful unknown-candidate recovery, distinguish a static written-type dictionary from context-conditioned occurrence selection without supervised expansion pairs. Keep the recovered candidate inventory fixed and predict which alternative each occurrence requires.1160 establishes historical context value only with supplied candidate domains;1164 tests unpaired type-level candidate recovery, not this occurrence-level bridge.

design.production_hypothesis: A historical writing channel conflates several source whole words into one observed marked whole. Neighbouring written context can disambiguate the occurrence even when neither key nor candidate inventory was initially supplied. No homography is asserted for Voynich.
design.positive_dependency: GDT1160 REPORT supports supervised occurrence disambiguation and neural increment; its21,512 cases and2,414 neural errors remain complete.
design.unmet_dependency: GDT1164 must first pass its unchanged predeclared promotion gates. Until its locked result, no inventory is available for this proposal. If1164 fails, do not use this as an automatic repair, expand its references or replace its objective.

finite_contrast.TYPE_ONLY: Every occurrence of one written type receives the same frozen candidate ranking.
finite_contrast.OCCURRENCE_CONTEXT: Ranking over exactly that type’s fixed candidates varies with the separately paid context model and anonymous neighbour candidates; no occurrence-specific free entry or gold training pair.

design.unequal_written_consequence: For a held exact written type with multiple true expansions, TYPE_ONLY makes identical predictions at all sites. OCCURRENCE_CONTEXT must correctly change its top choice across sites using context, including repeated candidate reversals, without changing candidate membership. Candidate omission remains an error in the primary denominator; conditionally in-inventory accuracy may be reported only separately.
design.possible_smallest_contract: Use only a future separately registered source split and frozen successfully recovered candidate sets; compare static ranking to one bounded context chooser with the same inventory. Infer neighbouring values jointly or marginalize them, rather than supply oracle neighbouring plaintext. All choices, selection nulls and out-of-inventory denominators must be fixed prospectively. No implementation requested here.
design.why_distinct: 1160 learned from paired expansions and supplied domains;1164 ranks candidates by written type. This explicitly removes paired occurrence supervision while requiring actual context-dependent selection from a frozen independently obtained inventory. It is not more restarts or source-language re-labelling.
failure_modes: Reference register mismatch may make context systematically prefer the wrong frequent function word.
Soft neighbouring candidates can reinforce mutually wrong assignments.
A candidate ranker may include true values without enough mass or local contrast to select them.
Context-sensitive readings can become arbitrary exceptions unless model complexity and all occurrences are paid.
Even successful source recovery would not identify the Voynich channel or translate a word.

predecessors.retained: Conditional source success, no unsupervised candidate induction claim.
Ongoing frozen test must finish unchanged; this RAW is neither a suggested live change nor post-result rescue.
Correct wholeword mappings existed among old restarts but wrong ones scored higher;97.4198% failed its99%floor. Better optimization cannot rescue a misranking objective.
Same-form role counterexample retained. Allowing contextual senses here does not reassign its failed dictionary or repair its construction.

design.research_decision: Only demonstrated recovery of occurrence choices without paired keys would justify considering occurrence-specific lexical alternatives in a later exploratory native account. Failure would retain static candidate uncertainty and reject this fixed bridge, not claim words cannot be recovered.
design.access: Only route/topic/registry and predecessor reports/METHOD read. No1164extract, fit arrays, gold, held data, target query, images, contacts or experiment code.
design.word_rule: No Voynich gloss selected. Any later native proposal must retrieve exact word profiles and all counterexamples; context effects cannot justify narrow meanings for broadly dispersed forms.
